observations.quote: 尽早用已有源片、本地排版和声音资产制作完整候选，再逐步改善去字、贴合和音质。
observations.finding: Can bias toward a locally complete candidate before background/design checks; this is a plausible guidance risk, not proof of agent motivation.
Unqualified allowed variation obscures source hierarchy and motion goals.
visible_coverup=false alone did not require explicit per-instance source-letter removal, background continuity and motion judgments.
Assessment severity could ignore explicit current-video negative cover observations in the immutable delivery package.

actions: Retain source design before erasure; compare original/base/translated frames before expansion.
Append natural-removal constraints after custom shot prompts; retain ImageGen/Wan choice based on content.
Require explicit v2 background observations for quality pass, pending by default.
Read same-video negative cover evidence before publication; do not silently rewrite legacy decisions.
proof_boundary: Implementation and deterministic regression scope. Actual production-frame investigation is local/private; no claim of flawless video, model superiority, arbitrary-font recovery or cross-source successful repair.
causal_hypothesis: Fast-completion and weak variation wording may encourage overusing fallback patches. Actual motivation cannot be established from unused budget.
